title: Add licensing to your app
summary: Licensing how-to with page-level SDK choice, own-UI lane, state copy keys and Help URLs.
compare: SDK choice is separate from lane tabs.
Own UI lists every state with its copy key and Help URL.
The check uses Verified rather than a success pill.

designReview.reviewer: ResumeDocsWave.DocsMockupLensReview: one reviewer agent, consumer, developer and brand lenses in a single pass

lenses.consumer: Walked in the combined pass; no finding raised for this screen.
lenses.developer: Walked in the combined pass; 1 finding(s) raised, applied below.
lenses.brand: Walked in the combined pass; 1 finding(s) raised, applied below.

designReview.verdict: Combined three-lens pass ended PASS after its findings were applied; the PR #65 fix round (below) is checked by the contract check only, not re-reviewed by a lens.

findings.issue: Six SDK labels overflowed the phone picker.
findings.resolution: Phone now retains the selected Swift tab and exposes a compact “5 more” affordance; desktop and tablet retain all SDK labels.

findings.issue: The guide asserted Verified without showing the App and Console route to Integration, and the displayed Help URLs did not match the message-id redirector.
findings.resolution: Added App and Console numbered steps that point from the licensing gate to Integration → Licensing → Verified on macOS; every state row now uses its exact message id in `/docs/help/code/<id>/`.

findings.issue: The desktop header stopped at search and omitted shared Docs chrome.
findings.resolution: Restored Developer changelog, Console and Theme controls.

designReview.notRun: Plan §8.4 and the DOC-01 brief ask for three separate pkey-ux-reviewer passes (consumer, developer, brand consistency). Those three separate passes were not run. One reviewer agent (ResumeDocsWave.DocsMockupLensReview) walked the three lenses as sections of a single pass over saved renders, then re-checked after fixes. The PR #65 fixes recorded above were verified with tools/mockups/check.mjs and shoot.mjs --check only; no lens re-review followed them.
